cleaning_procedure.unit_of_analysis: one game (gameid); best-of series are not reconstructed
cleaning_procedure.row_types: team rows = participantid 100/200 with position 'team'; player rows = participantid 1-10 with position top/jng/mid/bot/sup; anything else is excluded and reported
game_validation: same date on both team rows
cleaning_procedure.missing_values: kept as NULL; never converted to zero
cleaning_procedure.team_identity: source teamid; team name used only when teamid is missing (flagged id_from_name)
cleaning_procedure.tournament: league + year + split from the source
